It reads /work/reg.nc (the full 60x60 region, daily 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05) and /work/tg.nc (92 target days), both written in C4. It builds per-cell Hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day index windows, smooths them over 31 days, and compares only target-day doys 153-244, so it reads thresholds for doys 138-259, i.e. baseline dates 12 May to 20 September of each year. Hot days are compared with T>=thr, then runs of at least 5 hot days are found and gaps of 1-2 days joined for each sea cell before writing mh."}
